decisions.reason: The population projection is nationwide and its key claim is numerical/structural; a locator map would not materially improve understanding.
The two landfalls and affected provinces have clear spatial meaning, but mobile-native cannot claim the local canonical map renderer executed.
The housing-sales reform is a nationwide policy event rather than a location-dependent claim.
The Nepal-Tibet border flood and barrier-lake risk are strongly spatial, but mobile-native cannot claim a locally rendered canonical map asset.
The Strait of Hormuz is a geographic chokepoint central to the story, but mobile-native cannot claim a generated canonical map asset.
The outbreak's spread across provinces and health zones has spatial value, but mobile-native cannot claim the local canonical map renderer executed.
